description: The chart illustrates a comparison of two models’ scores across six evaluation settings spanning three datasets (TriviaQA, HotPotQA, 2Wiki) measured under EM and F1 metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categorical conditions labeled, from left to right: “TriviaQA (EM),” “HotPotQA (EM),” “2Wiki (EM),” “TriviaQA (F1),” “HotPotQA (F1),” and “2Wiki (F1).” The vertical axis is a numeric score scale shown on a linear axis with labeled ticks at approximately 25, 65, and 85 (with additional unlabeled gridlines between), covering roughly the 25–85 range. Each category has two adjacent bars (grouped side-by-side): a blue bar for “Flan-T5-783M” and a red bar for “GPT-4,” as indicated by the legend at the top. The bar values are printed on the bars: for TriviaQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M is 77.3 (blue) and GPT-4 is 77.1 (red); for HotPotQA (EM), Flan-T5-783M is 37.0 and GPT-4 is 31.9; for 2Wiki (EM), Flan-T5-783M is 44.5 and GPT-4 is 32.5; for TriviaQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M is 82.8 and GPT-4 is 83.8; for HotPotQA (F1), Flan-T5-783M is 49.7 and GPT-4 is 43.3; and for 2Wiki (F1), Flan-T5-783M is 53.3 and GPT-4 is 38.1. The categories appear in a fixed dataset/metric order rather than being sorted by bar height, and there are no special visual emphases beyond the color coding and numeric annotations on each bar.
